title: Level 4 (Expert) - D-28
notes:
West leads the ♣K against 4♠. South has certain losers in both diamonds and clubs and 2 likely losers in hearts as West is a big favorite to hold the ♥J given his 2♥ overcall. South's best chance for avoiding 2 heart losers is to play along elimination lines.

South should allow West's ♣K opening lead to hold the first trick so that East is unable to gain the lead in clubs (heart leads by East through South's ♥K102 would not be welcome). West continues clubs and South wins the ♣A. South should draw trump and ruff dummy's last club to eliminate that suit.

South should continue with 3 rounds of diamonds. If West wins the third round of diamonds, he is endplayed into either leading away from the ♥A or conceding a ruff and discard. If East wins the third round of diamonds, his best defense is to return a heart. South must counter by rising with the ♥K and West must win the ♥A. West is endplayed and must either lead away from the ♥J or lead a club to concede a ruff and discard.
